title: Clinic question bank: bounds, 3D trigonometry, vectors, histograms, calculus and functions
subject: Mathematics
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 101 (Clinic question bank (portal, written for this lesson; original questions with mark-scheme answers))
intro: Lesson 101 (optional clinic). Choose two sets. Own 4MA1-style questions with a mark scheme; each set is 4 to 6 marks.

questions.q: a = 6.4 and b = 2.1, both to 1 d.p. Find the upper bound of a ÷ b (3 s.f.). [2]
A rectangle is 12 cm by 8 cm, each to the nearest cm. Find the lower bound of its area. [2]
Find the length of the diagonal of a 3 cm by 4 cm by 12 cm cuboid. [2]
The cuboid stands on its 3 cm by 4 cm face. Find the angle between the diagonal and the base. [2]
questions.a: Base diagonal 5 cm; tan θ = 12 ÷ 5 M1; θ = 67.4° A1

questions.q: OA = a and OB = b. M is the midpoint of AB. Find OM. [2]
questions.a: AB = b - a M1; OM = a + ½(b - a) = ½(a + b) A1

questions.q: P lies on AB with AP : PB = 2 : 1. Find OP. [3]
questions.a: AP = ⅔(b - a) M1; OP = a + ⅔(b - a) M1 = ⅓a + ⅔b A1

questions.q: The class 10 < t ≤ 30 has frequency 50. Find its frequency density. [1]
The bar for 30 < t ≤ 40 has frequency density 4.2. Find its frequency. [1]
Use calculus to find the turning point of y = x² - 8x + 3 and say whether it is a maximum or minimum. [3]
questions.a: dy/dx = 2x - 8 = 0 M1; x = 4, y = -13 A1; (4, -13), a minimum (positive x² term) A1

questions.q: f(x) = x² and g(x) = x - 4. Solve fg(x) = 25. [3]
